name: Pebl
one_line: An AI assistant embedded in Pebl's employer-of-record platform that answers global employment questions, builds workforce reports from the customer's Pebl data, and submits or approves time-off requests for the user who asks.

configs.what: Alfie as embedded in the Pebl platform for Pebl customers, with what it may read and do set by the user's role (employee, manager, company admin).

facts.label: It works in one domain's data
facts.fact: Alfie works inside Pebl's global employment platform, on that platform's employment, compensation, time-off and invoice data.
facts.quote: embedded across Pebl’s global employment platform

facts.label: It is a vendor's assistant, used as supplied
facts.fact: Pebl's FAQ says Pebl built and maintains Alfie, which customers use inside the Pebl platform as supplied.
facts.quote: Alfie was built and is maintained by Pebl

facts.label: A limit on it is a rule in prose
facts.fact: The FAQ states in prose that every interaction with Alfie respects the user's role-level permissions and that Alfie does not bypass them; it also says personal data is processed only as needed for a response.
facts.quote: Alfie inherits platform permissions, it does not bypass them

facts.label: Its limits and known failure cases are documented for those who use it
facts.fact: The FAQ says AI can make mistakes, that users must keep human oversight, and that outputs are not legal, tax or professional advice.
facts.quote: AI can make mistakes. Users must ensure appropriate human oversight

facts.label: The data it uses is described
facts.fact: The FAQ says Pebl's own models are trained on vetted global hiring documentation and that Alfie may use the customer's Pebl account data.
facts.quote: Alfie may leverage your Pebl account data to provide contextual answers

facts.label: The models and third-party components it uses are listed
facts.fact: The FAQ names the model families Alfie uses: Claude (Anthropic), ChatGPT (OpenAI), Gemini (Google) and Cortex (Snowflake), plus Pebl's own models; no versions are given.
facts.quote: Claude by Anthropic, ChatGPT by OpenAI, Gemini by Google and Cortex by Snowflake

help.label: Our hypothesis, not their claim. Built from public pages only; nothing of theirs was tested.
help.pitch: RiskMandate would measure, for one real deployment of Pebl's agents, what each agent was asked to do (its mandate), what its credentials and connections actually let it reach (its grant), and the difference between the two (the gap), and keep that as a written record. It is read-only: never in the request path.
